description: Use first for a vague, natural-language repair need you will answer, e.g. "my T490 battery is dying". Keyword browsing: search_parts. Exact part number: get_part. Known slug: get_model_parts. A part number returns status resolved with that part and next = get_part_fits (type ignored). Otherwise type, if given, overrides any type word in query; else the type word is used; the rest must name one model. resolved: the model, candidate_count (all its documented parts of that type), candidates (the first 10, compact) and next = a get_model_parts call with model and type; with no type it also asks which part. needs_clarification: ONE clarifying_question to ask instead of guessing (5G vs Wi-Fi, Intel vs AMD, generation, touch), up to 40 candidate models, and next = retry with the chosen slug. not_found has fit_status no_documented_fit (no document, not incompatibility); did_you_mean offers a spelling fix to retry, never auto-applied. Read-only.

query.description: Required. The user's words (max 200 characters): a model plus part, or an OEM part number with or without dashes, e.g. "T490 battery", "surface pro 11 screen", "L40094001", "01FR025".

type.description: Optional part type, case-insensitive, as listed by get_coverage, e.g. "Battery", "Screen", "Keyboard", "Power Adapter", "SSD", "Memory". Overrides a type word in query; omit it to use the type word, or to be asked which part.

name: resolve_request

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

title: Resolve a vague part request
